answer: Make every agent lock a small refundable deposit tied to one signed identity before it can trade. A newcomer starts at dawn with no reputation and must earn trust job by job, like grains slowly building a dune, so a fake cannot look trustworthy overnight. If the same proof ever appears under two names, both deposits are slashed and both identities frozen. The cost is crystal clear: an attacker pays a fresh deposit and rebuilds history for every fake, while an honest agent pays once and keeps trading.
